title: Periodic Joint Co-tiles of Independent Tiles
summary: For every $d\geq2$, we prove that $d-1$ independent finite tiles in $\Z^d$ admit a fully periodic joint co-tile whenever they admit a joint co-tile. Here independence means that the tiles contain the origin and every choice of one nonzero vector from each tile is linearly independent. This removes property $(\star)$ from the periodic existence theorem of Meyerovitch, Sanadhya and Solomon and recovers Bhattacharya's theorem when $d=2$.
